title: Streamable HTTP adapter
description: Objective: expose the same generated MCP surface over official Streamable HTTP for long-lived clients. Deliverable: packages/mcp HTTP modules and parity tests. NOT in scope: custom WebSocket protocol or browser UI APIs. Hard dependency: Official MCP stdio adapter. Owned paths: packages/mcp/src/http/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/mcp test.
definitionOfDone: Tool/result/error bytes are semantically parity-tested with stdio.
Session authentication, bounds, resume, cancellation, and disconnect behavior fail closed.
taskRails: Portability consumes frozen daemon/core contracts; adapters cannot fork lifecycle or authority semantics.
Official MCP stdio and Streamable HTTP only; no custom MCP-over-WebSocket dialect.
Unsupported OS/provider/import facts remain typed UNSUPPORTED or UNKNOWN, never guessed.
IDE adapters are thin optional shells for the standalone control room. Keep files below 400 lines and use explicit owned paths.
